question: V Satyanarayana Sharma is recognised as a __________ classical dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **V Satyanarayana Sharma** was an Indian classical dancer and choreographer, considered by many as one of the leading exponents of the **classical dance form of Kuchipudi.**
 
• He was known for his portrayal of** female characters such as Usha, Satyabhama, Mohini etc.**
 
• The Government of India awarded him the** fourth highest civilian honour of the Padma Shri, in 1970.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ **

 
• **​Sonal Mansingh,** a dancer of Odissi, a classical Indian dance form that originated in Orissa.
 
• **Elam Endira Devi** is an Indian classical dancer and teacher, known for her expertise and scholarship in the classical dance form of Manipuri.
 
• **Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev** is credited with developing Sattriya dance.​
